inferenceMethod: Anchor field scale with published foul/centre distances and 27.432 m base spacing.
Trace rounded home-corner and nearly straight wings from official plan; fit centripetal Catmull-Rom, using arc-length placement.
Use visible bay repetition and seat/aisle proportions; infer unobserved side from approximate symmetry.
Use explicit row rise/spacing and consistent slab/column/roof endpoints for hidden geometry.
Interpolate unknown fence contour with existing game radial exponent 1.5; do not claim surveyed contour.
limitations: No camera calibration or photogrammetry; structural dimensions are visual estimates.
Colours in older seat photographs do not prove 2026 colour arrangement; current blue seating palette is estimated.
Current ads are representative, not a verified exact 2026 arrangement.
Skyline heights and positions are estimated.
Generic players and crowd sprites remain; this is not a completed photorealistic game.
